raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-SLE-ConnectivityAgMarketInfra",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Soaring macroeconomic inflation and global supply shocks in Sierra Leone could cause significant cost overruns for civil works and infrastructure components.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Include price contingency provisions in major works contracts, conduct market pricing surveys, and monitor procurement budgets regularly.",
      "evidence": "macroeconomic environment, which is characterized by intensified fiscal pressures, soaring inflation driven by global supply shocks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Heavy seasonal rainfall, intense river flooding, and landslides could cause civil works suspensions, erosion, and structural damage to rural bridges and link roads under construction.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 5,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate climate-proofed technical design standards, elevate approach embankments, right-size drainage culverts, and schedule heavy foundation works during the dry season.",
      "evidence": "prolonged rainy season... leading to a rise in water levels in river crossings... civil works in the four sites were suspended"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "GoSL fiscal stress could delay or prevent the provision of committed counterpart funds ($3.1 million) needed to complete ongoing SCADeP bridge contracts.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish a legally binding counterpart contribution schedule with the Ministry of Finance and prioritize initial disbursements from Subcomponent 2b grant funds.",
      "evidence": "Leaves a funding gap of about US$7.1 million... Considering the current fiscal stress on the GoSL... government has committed to cover the remaining US$3.1 million"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Institutional fragmentation and overlapping mandates among MTA, SLRA, SLRSA, and Traffic Police could result in poor inter-agency coordination and delayed project execution.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Formalize inter-agency coordination mechanisms through the National Project Steering Committee (NPSC) and define explicit institutional roles in the Project Implementation Manual.",
      "evidence": "institutional framework for transport sector management in Sierra Leone is fragmented and lacks systematic coordination among the multiple agencies operating with overlapping responsibilities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Lack of an established procurement unit and limited familiarity with World Bank procurement regulations and STEP at MTA/PCIU could cause procurement delays and non-compliance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit qualified Procurement and Financial Management Specialists prior to project effectiveness, institute proper record-keeping systems, and provide continuous hands-on STEP training.",
      "evidence": "PCIU is yet to be established and the capacity of procurement staff in MTA is low; there is a lack of knowledge in using World Bank’s Procurement Regulations"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Low internet penetration and digital literacy gaps among rural farmers, particularly women, may inhibit the widespread adoption and utilization of the upgraded AMIS mobile app.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Integrate offline access channels such as Integrated Voice Response (IVR) systems, partner with community women's groups, and deliver tailored grassroots digital literacy training.",
      "evidence": "internet penetration standing at 21.2 percent... rural women and farmers often have limited access to mobile phones based on factors such as literacy rates"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Informal paratransit operators (poda-podas, okadas, kekes) may resist formalization and high-capacity bus priority schemes, causing operational conflicts or service disruptions.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage informal transport associations early, facilitate their integration into corporate entities (like MTC), and incorporate them into scheduled feeder bus operation contracts.",
      "evidence": "Public transport services are experiencing a rapid growth of unregulated informal providers... Engaging private operators including bus operators... is the key to modernize"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Insufficient road maintenance funding from the Road Maintenance Fund Administration (RMFA) and ad-hoc maintenance allocation could cause rapid post-construction deterioration of road and bridge assets.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Operationalize the Bridge Management System (BMS) and Road Asset Management System (RAMS) to prioritize data-driven maintenance and support national transport strategy reforms for road fund sustainability.",
      "evidence": "RMFA collected approximately US$12.5 million... which is a small fraction of the actual support needed for road maintenance... decision-making on road maintenance... is ad hoc"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Labor influx for rural bridge and urban infrastructure civil works increases the risk of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse and Sexual Harassment (SEA/SH) in local communities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce worker codes of conduct, adopt a comprehensive SEA/SH Action Plan, conduct community awareness campaigns, and establish a secure, gender-sensitive grievance mechanism.",
      "evidence": "assess the risks related to SEA/SH and prepare an SH/SEA action plan... Sexual Exploitation and Abuse/Sexual Harassment Action Plan consistent with the ESCP"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Delays in fulfilling time-bound legal covenants and disbursement conditions (e.g., establishing NPSC, adopting PIM, procuring accounting software) could stall initial project implementation.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize Project Preparation Advance (PPA) funding to complete draft manuals, recruit core PCIU personnel, and finalize accounting system software selection prior to effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "Schedule 2, Section I. A. 2(a)... Section IV, 1... Section IV, 2... Article IV 4.01.(a)... adopt and disclose updated ESMP, ESIA, RAP"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Land acquisition and economic displacement along bridge approach roads, bus corridors, and market sites could trigger disputes and delay civil works commencement.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Update and disclose Resettlement Action Plans (RAPs) early, conduct transparent stakeholder consultations, and fully execute compensation prior to site handover to contractors.",
      "evidence": "updated Resettlement Action Plan for Component 2... potential relocation of the project-affected people and sitting of the proposed bridges and agricultural market infrastructure"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Manual and unsynchronized road incident data collection across SLRSA and Police impedes effective safety monitoring and targeted traffic enforcement.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Finance the establishment of a centralized digital road safety database and national guidelines while delivering joint training to SLRSA and traffic police officers.",
      "evidence": "There is no systematic database on road safety, and Sierra Leone Road Safety Authority (SLRSA) and the police department collect road incidents manually"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Heavy vehicle overloading on newly constructed long-span rural bridges and link roads could cause premature structural fatigue and shorten asset life.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Design bridge structures with structural redundancy and allowance for vehicle overloads, install scour protection, and build SLRA capacity for continuous bridge lifecycle monitoring.",
      "evidence": "The bridges will also be checked for resilience to climate change exacerbated floods, landslides, extreme temperature, and potential vehicles’ overloads."
    }
  ]
}
